hard offtrack soft offtrack collision-risk failure and boundary-tolerated diagnostic columns are generated

no rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made

decision_rule: M2438 passes if it builds a complete non-ranking hard/soft offtrack metric split panel from existing episode rows and routes to result audit without rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
